svg.text: wife of Seleucus I, then his son
general and regent for Antiochus VI —
Seleucus I married Apama, daughter of the Sogdian leader Spitamenes: from Antiochus I onward every Seleucid carried Iranian descent.
Cleopatra Thea reigned in her own right and bore four kings to three successive husbands — Balas, Demetrius II and Antiochus VII.
From 129 BCE rival branches ruled simultaneously from different cities; the reign dates below Grypus overlap and do not form a single succession.
